extension.summary: Updates and patches games from the USB update port, only when the bundle information matches
extension.description: Reads patch packages from the USB Update Port while Kodi is running. A patch is applied only when it names this exact bundle (StoreID) and a bundle version at or below the one installed, and only when every file's SHA-256 checksum matches. Patches are written to the writable Kodi home (emulator cores, add-ons, a patched-games overlay) and never to the read-only bundle or the VCS Bundle drive. Replaced files are backed up first. Open it from Programs to see and apply any waiting patches.
